thread: Ada: Quick UX catch from design review — the in-product Help panel uses the term "model snapshot" in the UI but our docs and API use "model version". Users in the panel that click "Learn more" land on the docs anchor titled "Versioning" which is confusing. Lucas: Ugh, yeah. I noticed that last week in the mockups. The help panel copy came from an old brief. Can we pick one canonical term? my vote: "model version" (matches API). Sophia: +1 to "model version". Docs already reference "model version" heavily — easier to maintain one term. I'll update the docs anchors if we decide. Ben: From a frontend perspective the help panel links are deep-linking to #versioning but the console routes v2 -> /console/models/:id/details. The anchor jump doesn't set focus which breaks keyboard users. We should add focus management when navigating to anchors. Chandra: Accessibility nit: when a help link opens a docs anchor in a new tab we need rel="noopener" and aria-label that clarifies it's external. Also the in-panel link text "Learn more" is too vague for screen reader users — prefer "Learn more about model versions (opens in new tab)". Ada: Good call. Also spotted some inconsistent CTA labels: "Edit snapshot" vs "Edit version" in the settings flyout. Might be a leftover. Lucas can we get a sweep of all labels in the panel and settings? Lucas: I'll do a quick audit. Will replace "snapshot" with "version" across mockups. Can we standardize on the short label "Version" for table headers and "Model version" in help copy? Sophia: That works. I'll add an alias in the docs to catch legacy links: add an H2 with id="snapshot" that redirects to #versioning and a short note explaining the rename to avoid 404s. Ben: Implementation notes for engineers: 1) Update anchor links to use full URL with hash to ensure proper navigation. 2) After navigation, run: document.getElementById('main-content').focus(); 3) Add aria-describedby on the external link: Learn more about model versions Chandra: Also make sure keyboard users don't get trapped — test tab order after focus jump. And add skip-link to the docs anchor where possible. Ada: UX copy change suggestion (to be reviewed): - In panel header: "Model versions" (plural) - Inline help: "Model version — pin a specific model build to ensure consistent outputs. Learn more about model versions (opens in new tab)." Sophia: I'll draft the docs change and add the alias H2. Also will add a short paragraph about backwards compatibility for "snapshot" term. Ben: I'll queue a frontend PR for focus handling + link text. Will include unit test for focus behavior. PR will reference this thread. Lucas: Design tasks: update Figma labels, update copy tokens in the design system, and ensure components expose props for aria-label/link text. Ada: Who wants ownership to coordinate rollout? We need doc changes, FE PR, and a small design update. Sophia: I can own docs and the alias. Ben: I'll own the frontend changes. Lucas: I'll own the design updates and make sure tokens are updated. Chandra: I'll review accessibility in the review and sign off. Ada: Great — TL;DR action items: - Sophia: docs alias + copy update (ETA 2 days) - Ben: FE PR for focus + link text (ETA 3 days) - Lucas: design tokens + Figma updates (ETA 2 days) - Chandra: accessibility review (after PRs) docs-bot: Created task #4821: "Standardize \"model snapshot\" -> \"model version\" in console help panel; add anchor alias and a11y fixes" assigned to Sophia, Ben, Lucas. Ada: Thanks team. After changes land let's do a quick pairing session to test keyboard/voiceover behavior. :thumbsup:
